metadata.title: Discovering action insights from large-scale assessment log data using machine learning

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values for achievement scores as it focuses on performance groups derived from action-sequence logs.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The matching, text-readable full PDF does not report use or explicit non-use of sampling weights; full-text search found no weight terminology. Original extraction rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights and treats the data as a convenience sample without weighting.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, focusing instead on log data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as clustering and classification accuracy checks but does not validate findings on external datasets.

design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): The study used the 2012 PIAAC dataset… validated across two problem sets (“Party Invitation” and “Club Membership”). No separate analyses by country/education system or cross-system comparison are described in the excerpts.
